items.title: 96 percent of congressional prediction markets could be moved five cents for 3,500 dollars or less, ACDC finds, Gambling Insider reports
items.content_text: - **96 percent of congressional prediction markets could be moved five cents for 3,500 dollars or less, ACDC finds, Gambling Insider reports** — Gambling Insider reports Anti-Corruption Data Collective research covering 28,845 congressional markets across Kalshi, Polymarket and Polymarket US found 96 percent of markets with live order books could be shifted five cents for 3,500 dollars or less, and 66 percent for under 100 dollars. It also found the top 1 percent of Polymarket wallets now account for 75 percent of congressional trading volume, up from 68 percent in August. (Gambling Insider)

items.content_text: - **UBS assigns 50 percent odds to a Democratic sweep of Congress, well below the 75 percent Polymarket prices, Market Flux reports** — Market Flux reports Polymarket put the probability of a full Democratic sweep at 75 percent, a figure that rose to new highs throughout Election Day, with Democrats at 95 percent for the House and 77 percent for the Senate.
